name: OneUptime Cloud Free
free_limit: Hosted $0 Free plan includes 1 public status page, 100 subscribers, unlimited manual monitors and basic incident management; no credit card required to sign up.
watch_out: Active monitors are billed at $1/month each; SMS, calls, telemetry ingestion and advanced features may incur separate charges. No uptime SLA on Free. Distinct from free self-hosted Community Edition.
